rule: top N Nasdaq-listed symbols by displayed continuous-session volume (ITCH E + printable C shares between system events Q and M) on the selection day; ETFs (etp_flag Y) kept and flagged; test securities (authenticity T) excluded; crosses and hidden prints reported, not ranked; fixed on the selection day (no re-selection on later days)
survivorship_note: the universe is the selection day's top N; a symbol that later delists, halts or changes id stays in the list and is reported as missing on that day
